words.sense: Lacking a clear plan or consistent purpose
words.concise_meaning: jumping aimlessly from one thing to another
words.connotation: negative (implies lack of commitment or structure)
misconceptions: confusing it with being just fast

words.sense: Done quickly and without attention to detail
words.connotation: negative (implies neglect or lack of thoroughness)

semantic_axes.description: The presence of a structured, focused goal vs. erratic, aimless movement.
The level of attention given to details vs. hasty, superficial treatment.

edge.boundary_rule: Use desultory for erratic, aimless behavior; use cursory for hasty, superficial behavior.

misconceptions.M1: Assuming any lack of success is desultory.
misconceptions.M2: Assuming any quick look is desultory.
misconceptions.M3: Assuming being aimless means being fast (confusing it with cursory).

desultory: His desultory approach meant he never completed the task.
The committee had a desultory discussion, shifting from agenda to agenda without resolution.
She made desultory attempts to clean her room, starting with books then switching to clothes.
The team's desultory efforts left the project in chaos.
A desultory search for a partner left him lonely.
Their desultory play style failed to build momentum.
cursory: A cursory review of the documents revealed several errors.
He gave the painting a cursory glance and walked away.
The doctor's cursory exam failed to find the underlying issue.
A cursory inspection of the vehicle showed no visible damage.
The manager did a cursory check of the inventory list.
She took a cursory look at the map before driving off.

desultory: The review was too fast and missed errors.
He glanced at the paper and ignored the instructions.
She scanned the files to find the specific date.
The inspection was superficial and lacked depth.
He rushed through the contract without reading it.
The assessment was too hasty to be accurate.
cursory: The group jumped from topic to topic without purpose.
His study habits are erratic and lack a clear plan.
The athlete's training was disjointed and lacked focus.
The artist's work feels scattered and lacks a unified vision.
She spends her time flitting from one project to another.
The presentation was poorly structured and wandered.

borderline.text: The student's check of the notes was so fast they missed the key facts.
borderline.note: Focus on the speed/lack of depth.

borderline.text: The student's note-taking shifted from topic to topic with no logical order.
borderline.note: Focus on the lack of structure/aimlessness.

borderline.text: The investigation was performed in a rush and lacked proper depth.
borderline.note: The speed is the key failure.

borderline.text: The research effort was inconsistent and erratic in its execution.
borderline.note: The erratic nature suggests no plan.

chains.frame: The student's research process was ___

beats.text: The student spent their time clicking on random links about the history of Rome without reading anything.
beats.reason: The aimlessness is the main issue.

beats.text: Even after two hours, the student had not taken a single note, continuing to hop between unrelated Wikipedia pages.
beats.reason: The erratic behavior confirms the lack of purpose.

chains.feedback_short: The decisive clue is the lack of a plan, making it desultory rather than just hasty.
chains.feedback_deep: The student's behavior is erratic and lacks a clear, focused goal, which defines 'desultory'. Cursory refers to being fast and superficial, which might be a symptom of being aimless, but the lack of structure is the primary characteristic here.
chains.hint: Focus on the lack of a plan.

chains.frame: The manager's review of the project was ___

beats.text: The manager opened the project folder and skipped between files without checking any detail.
beats.reason: The erratic switching suggests aimlessness.

beats.text: It was clear the manager was only concerned with finishing before their lunch break, ignoring everything of substance.
beats.reason: The urgency/haste changes the focus from aimless to superficial.

chains.feedback_short: The decisive clue is the haste to finish, making it cursory.
chains.feedback_deep: Initially, the manager's action looked aimless, fitting 'desultory'. However, the new information shows they were actually rushing to finish, making the action superficial and 'cursory'.
chains.contrast_rule: Haste shifts focus from aimlessness to superficiality.
chains.hint: Why are they looking at the project?

chains.frame: The journalist's research was ___

beats.text: The journalist skimmed the report in seconds, ignoring the appendices.
beats.reason: The speed shows a lack of depth.

beats.text: Without checking the facts, they submitted the article for publication immediately.
beats.reason: This reinforces the haste and lack of depth.

chains.feedback_short: The decisive clue is the lack of thoroughness, meaning it was just a superficial scan.
chains.feedback_deep: The journalist is in a rush and fails to engage with the material properly. This superficial haste is the definition of 'cursory'.
chains.hint: Check the thoroughness of the work.

chains.frame: The painter's work on the canvas was ___

beats.text: The painter moved between different corners of the canvas, applying paint here and there without finishing any section.
beats.reason: The lack of order suggests aimlessness.

beats.text: This lack of a plan meant the composition lacked cohesion.
beats.reason: This confirms the aimless nature.

chains.feedback_short: The decisive clue is the lack of a clear plan, confirming the aimlessness.
chains.feedback_deep: The painter is jumping around without finishing, creating an aimless effect. 'Desultory' accurately captures this lack of purposeful direction and structure.

chains.frame: The musician's practice was ___

beats.text: The musician played a few bars of a scale, then switched to a song, then back to the scale.
beats.reason: The switching is erratic.

beats.text: They were not really focusing on any technique, just playing whatever came to mind.
beats.reason: The aimlessness is reaffirmed, not flipped.

chains.feedback_short: The decisive clue is the playing of whatever came to mind, maintaining aimlessness.
chains.feedback_deep: The musician is jumping between things without a plan. This is classic aimless behavior, which is 'desultory'. The new information supports this, making it a false shift (no change).
chains.contrast_rule: False shifts keep the same classification.

chains.frame: The gardener's planning was ___

beats.text: The gardener started digging a hole, then stopped to pull weeds, then left to get water without finishing anything.
beats.reason: The erratic behavior suggests aimlessness.

beats.text: It became obvious this was because they had completely forgotten their initial plan for the day.
beats.reason: The aimlessness is explained as a lack of plan.

chains.feedback_short: The decisive clue is the lack of a plan, reframing the erratic behavior.
chains.feedback_deep: The gardener is acting without purpose because they forgot the plan. This lack of direction makes their actions aimless, which is the definition of 'desultory'.
chains.hint: Why are they jumping from task to task?

chains.frame: The lawyer's review of the case law was ___

beats.text: The lawyer looked at the precedents for only a few minutes before drawing conclusions.
beats.reason: The speed suggests haste.

beats.text: They failed to notice the crucial distinction in the Supreme Court ruling.
beats.reason: The lack of depth (missing crucial details) makes it cursory.

chains.feedback_short: The decisive clue is the lack of depth (missing crucial details), making it cursory.
chains.feedback_deep: The lawyer is in a rush and fails to engage properly, leading to a superficial, 'cursory' review.

chains.frame: The doctor's exam was ___

beats.text: The doctor barely looked at the patient's records and then quickly left the room.
beats.reason: Lack of attention suggests superficiality.

beats.text: The patient was frustrated because the doctor hadn't even checked their blood pressure.
beats.reason: This reinforces the lack of thoroughness.

chains.feedback_short: The decisive clue is the lack of thoroughness, making it cursory.
chains.feedback_deep: The doctor is rushing and not being thorough, fitting 'cursory'.

chains.frame: The architect's design process was ___

beats.text: The architect was sketching things on various napkins, jumping from kitchen layouts to bedroom designs without focus.
beats.reason: The aimlessness is the key.

beats.text: They only spent five minutes on each sketch, so none of the designs actually met building codes.
beats.reason: The haste and superficiality take over.

chains.feedback_short: The decisive clue is the haste (five minutes), making it cursory.
chains.feedback_deep: Initially, the architect's work was aimless ('desultory'), but the focus on the speed and lack of quality ('five minutes') reframes it as 'cursory'.

chains.frame: The developer's coding approach was ___

beats.text: The developer worked on the authentication module, then switched to the UI, then to the database without a plan.
beats.reason: The erratic nature suggests aimlessness.

beats.text: The project was behind schedule because nothing had been completed.
beats.reason: This confirms the erratic, aimless nature.

chains.feedback_short: The decisive clue is the lack of a plan, making it desultory.
chains.feedback_deep: The developer is working in an aimless, erratic fashion, which is the definition of 'desultory'.

chains.frame: The archivist's search was ___

beats.text: The archivist looked at the old files in a rush, just flipping through pages.
beats.reason: The speed is the key.

beats.text: This quick scan was far too shallow to be effective for historical study.
beats.reason: Confirms the superficiality.

chains.feedback_short: The decisive clue is the quick scan, making it cursory.
chains.feedback_deep: The archivist is rushing and being superficial, fitting 'cursory'.

chains.frame: The author's writing style in the draft was ___

beats.text: The author would write a scene, then delete it, then write a poem, then go back to the scene.
beats.reason: The aimless jumping is the key.

beats.text: Because they were only putting a few words down before moving on, the narrative was entirely lacking in depth.
beats.reason: The superficial haste is now the dominant feature.

chains.feedback_short: The decisive clue is the lack of depth caused by the rush, making it cursory.
chains.feedback_deep: The jumping was aimless ('desultory'), but the fact that they barely wrote anything ('few words') emphasizes the superficial, 'cursory' nature.

chains.frame: The committee's review of the policy was ___

beats.text: The committee spent very little time on each clause, effectively ignoring the details.
beats.reason: The haste is clear.

beats.text: They actually had a deliberate, albeit fast, strategy to only target specific controversial sections.
beats.reason: This rehabilitates it from being merely 'hasty', though still quick (cursory is still better than desultory).

chains.feedback_short: The decisive clue is the deliberate strategy, rehabilitating the perception of the review.
chains.feedback_deep: While it was quick ('cursory'), the strategy makes it more calculated than just a mindless, 'desultory' or purely 'hasty' action, yet 'cursory' remains the best fit for the speed and superficial focus.
chains.contrast_rule: Strategy can rehabilitate a cursory approach.

chains.frame: The scientist's observation of the results was ___

beats.text: The scientist glanced at the sensor readings once before turning their back.
beats.reason: The speed and lack of engagement is clear.

beats.text: They didn't record any of the data, as if the whole experiment was a waste of time.
beats.reason: Reinforces the superficial, hasty nature (not aiming to do a good job).

chains.feedback_short: The decisive clue is the lack of engagement and speed, maintaining the cursory description.
chains.feedback_deep: The scientist is rushing and not doing the work ('cursory'). The new info confirms the superficiality, but does not shift the word choice.

chains.feedback_short: The decisive clue is the lack of logical thought, confirming aimlessness (desultory).
chains.feedback_deep: The philosopher is behaving without purpose, jumping around erratically, which fits 'desultory'.

chains.frame: The analyst's examination of the data was ___

chains.feedback_short: The decisive clue is the haste, making it cursory.
chains.feedback_deep: The initial behavior looked aimless ('desultory'), but the focus on speed ('spending seconds') makes 'cursory' the best description of their superficial work.

chains.feedback_deep: The coach is acting in an aimless, unstructured way. This lack of direction fits 'desultory'.
